The strip shows one nearby person repeated across frames, standing several metres ahead on the path and facing toward the camera wearer and dogs. Three dogs move within roughly 1–4 metres; the closest dogs are within reach, while the person is not. The dogs partly cross the space between the wearer and the person, so keeping them controlled while greeting the person is the appropriate response. No one appears distressed or in need of water, and no dog shows clearly unusual behavior.
